product_metadata.title: Unique Party Setting Polka Dot Christmas Plastic Tablecloth, Red & Green, 108" x 54", Red and Green
features: 1 Red & Green Polka Dot Christmas Plastic Tablecloth
Excellent for any Christmas party or holiday party
Protects tables from spills and messes
Use with other Christmas party supplies from Unique
description: Deck out a party table with festive flair with this Red & Green Polka Dot Christmas Plastic Tablecloth. Measuring 108" x 54", and adorned with bright red and green polka dots, this plastic table cover will make it easy to trim up a table for a Christmas party or holiday party. Spread this tablecloth out over a holiday dinner table to keep it protected from globs of cranberry sauce and pie crumbs when friends and family sit down to eat. Or, spread it over a refreshment table to add holly jolly style to a display of holiday drinks and snacks.
